method: Traces from SP/sessions.pkl (extract.py); metrics.py, memloss.py, phantom.py, last25.py. 'near' repeat = same file with overlapping read range, or search whose identifier-token set is a subset/superset of an earlier one, or declaration_search of the same name, or #check subset. Phantom = declaration_search 'before this PR' hit whose file does not declare <Prefix>.<leaf> (approximate check against a base snapshot; exact sha where known). follow = later read/grep/goto/hover of a phantom file. Turn classes (last 25): construct > phantom_follow > repeat > tool_error > new_lookup, first match wins. follow counts are an upper bound: a phantom file can also be read for a legitimate reason (e.g. 33285's LinearIsometry.lean is a changed file; 34935's T74-79).
